text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduling a rollback drill for driver/CUDA/ROCm stack next Tue (2026-04-07). Goal: rehearse the cross-org rollback from `nvidia-driver 535.x + cuda 12.2` -> pinned `nvidia-driver 525.85 + cuda 11.8`, and ROCm fallback path. Need eng-runtime, eng-sre, partnerships, and marketplace owners. Planned timeline + checklist below.

sam: +1. I can own runtime steps. We'll test KV-cache warm/rebuild, quant paths, and plugin ABI checks. Do we have a canary image id?

daniel: Add ROCm test vectors — model perf/regression harness needs to run for 5 key workloads (chat, embed, rerank). I'll queue nightly runs on the canary cluster.

rachel: I'll draft partner comms. We should notify marketplace vendors and add a "maintenance drill" tag to marketplace images so they don't auto-promote during drill.

frank: Concern: SLA hit if traffic isn't properly routed. We should use routing policy -> region fallback, and keep a 5% canary traffic cap. Also need on-call rotation for the window.

jen: I'll ping HW partners (ACME, ORION) and marketplace PMs. Can we share the rollback playbook link? /cc @partners

maria: Playbook snippet (working draft):
```
1. Quiesce new deployments
2. Switch routing policy to pinned-model lane
3. Run revert script on Dedicated GPU pools:
   ./ops/revert-driver.sh --target 525.85 --cuda 11.8
4. Validate canary images (id: canary-20260407-01)
5. Promote if green, else rollback network route
```

sam: Note: runtime needs kernel module unload/reload step on the nodes. Command:
```
ssh ops@node-XXX 'sudo modprobe -r nvidia && sudo modprobe nvidia'
```
I'll add that to the script.

daniel: Also add perf/reg checks: latency, p95 token throughput, decode divergence. I'll attach the eval set after this thread.

rachel: Proposed comms timeline: 24h pre-notice -> partners, 2h before drill -> internal, 15m before -> public status page update.

frank: +1. Can we get a temporary SLA wavier logged? ops-ticket created: #DRILL-1234

jen: Partners confirmed for the window, ACME OK, ORION needs API key rotation scheduled 1h prior.

deploy-bot: Scheduled drill job queued: drill-run-1765432100 at 2026-04-07T17:00Z

maria: Volunteers to run the on-call play? I can be lead. Need someone from infra to watch kernel steps.

sam: I'll be infra lead. :thumbsup:

maria: Great — I'll follow up with a short runbook and invite calendar events. Thanks all.
